## Hardware Requirements for the Latest Version of Adobe Photoshop on Mac

Based on Adobe's official technical requirements page, here are the requirements for **Adobe Photoshop version 27.x and later** (the latest) on macOS:

| Component | Minimum | Recommended |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| **Processor** | Multicore Intel® or Apple Silicon processor | ARM-based Apple Silicon processor |
| **Operating System** | macOS v26, v15.x, v14.x (Cannot be installed on macOS 12.x.x (Monterey) or earlier) | macOS Sequoia (version 15.6.1) |
| **RAM** | 8 GB | 16 GB or more |
| **Graphics card** | GPU with Metal support (see Adobe's "Mac computers that support Metal" list) | — |
| **Monitor Resolution** | 1280 x 800 or higher | 1920 x 1080 display or higher |
| **Video RAM** | 1.5 GB | 2 GB |
| **Hard Disk Space** | 10 GB of available hard disk space for installation; additional free space required during installation | 100 GB of available hard disk space; Fast internal SSD for app installation; Additional high-speed drive(s) or SSD to set up scratch disks |
| **File System** | Cannot be installed on a volume that uses a case-sensitive file system | — |
| **Internet** | Internet connection and registration are necessary for required software activation, membership validation, and access to online services | — |

**Key additional notes for Intel-based Macs:**
- CPUs must have AVX2 support
- Platforms must have SSE 4.2 or higher support

**Source:** Adobe Help Center — "Adobe Photoshop on desktop technical requirements" (Last updated September 9, 2026)

In summary, while Photoshop will run on a minimum-spec Mac with an Intel/Apple Silicon processor and 8 GB RAM, Adobe strongly recommends an Apple Silicon (ARM) processor with 16 GB or more RAM and a fast internal SSD for the best performance.
